gates.title: Open-source runtime packaging
gates.acceptance: Qualify the eligible public Qt source build, exact module/QPA notices and hashes, shared-library/plugin closure and applicable source/library replacement materials. Keep evaluation and QNX SDK payloads separate. No paid Qt subscription prerequisite.

gates.title: Candidate CI
gates.acceptance: Successful required checks for the release candidate on authorized runners; local checks remain separately labeled.

gates.title: Repeatable graphics cold boot
gates.acceptance: 20 consecutive supervised cold boots on the named release board/image, with recovery and logs. Application relaunch trials do not count as cold boots.

gates.title: Device component and input results
gates.acceptance: Every component has a device disposition and tested limits on stock Pi 4 QSTI; prove keyboard/touch and the selected interaction scope. Pi 400 results stay separate.

gates.title: QNX performance measurements
gates.acceptance: Publish startup-to-first-frame, presented-frame intervals and RSS for Hello World, a 1000-row list and drawer drag, including revision, sample sizes and capture limitations.

gates.title: Clean-host app workflow
gates.acceptance: A new licensed developer can create, build, deploy and run an app from documented prerequisites. Verify actual package ownership and contents before any npm publication.

gates.title: Versioned v1 documentation
gates.acceptance: Published, versioned getting-started, API/support limits, evidence gallery, ADRs and release notes with reviewed local links.

gates.title: App identity: icon and name
gates.acceptance: Read the Expo icon field (optional extra.rnqnx.icon override), reject non-square or sub-1024 px sources in prepare-native and doctor, generate every target size at build time and hash it into native-app.json, and apply it to the launcher tile, title bar, task switcher and QGuiApplication::setWindowIcon (Marathon: app manifest). Ship a default template icon; never bake corner masks. Enforce tile-name fit by measured rendered width in the launcher font, with extra.rnqnx.shortName for the tile and expo.name for the title bar; fail with the measured overflow instead of truncating; keep the label single-line with elision. Tests cover longest fitting name, one glyph over, wide glyphs, CJK, emoji and RTL. Host and device receipts show the custom icon in every location and a tile grid where a maximum-length name and a short name produce identical tile sizes.

gates.title: Window chrome and windows API
gates.acceptance: A native QML title bar outside the Fabric root (icon, title, minimize, close; maximize if the target supports it) with macos and windows control layouts selectable in config and at runtime, titleBarStyle default/hidden/none, and a title bar inset exposed to JavaScript and SafeAreaView. Drag-move and edge resize only where the QNX QPA plugin is verified to support them. An ADR defines minimize on QNX Screen. A Nitro v1 HybridClass windows API covers title, size, position, minimize, close, close guards, focus and visibility events, and states multi-window scope. Controls are keyboard operable with visible focus and finger-sized hit targets. Device receipts show both layouts, minimize and restore with the AppState transition logged, a close guard that cancels and one that proceeds, and chrome still operable while the JS thread is deliberately blocked.

gates.title: Expo readiness
gates.acceptance: One-command create and an add-to-existing-Expo-app path; static app.json and dynamic app.config.js/.ts resolved through @expo/config; expo-qnx-config-plugins as the single source of native configuration with idempotent prebuild; Expo CLI owning Metro, logs and reload; a prebuilt, hash-verified, version-matched development runner for the QNX release board and for macOS and Linux hosts, a custom development build and a standalone package; a native-module requirement check before JavaScript loads; autolinking of Expo and Nitro modules outside this checkout; a test-generated Expo SDK 58 package support list; apps/expo-router-example running on device. Acceptance: on a clean host without the SDP, create an app, change name, icon and chrome layout only through Expo config and run it on the device in the downloaded runner with Fast Refresh; then with the SDP build and launch the standalone package on the device, recorded end to end.

gates.title: Packages updated
gates.acceptance: Every dependency row marked Bump in the v1 version baseline has landed; pnpm outdated -r output is attached with each remaining item bumped or held with a recorded reason; pnpm validate:dependencies, pnpm audit:dependencies, typecheck, host suites and the hosted workflows pass on the updated graph; the README dependency table is regenerated.
